investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Previous Similar Alert: SOC-99398 (User Login Location Anomaly at 2026-02-10T10:45:00.000Z from same IP)
investigation_notes.Description: A deletion of a production network security group succeeded against rg-baltic-prod-connectivity and was performed by a user assigned the Contributor role. The actor is a Senior DevOps Engineer in Architecture & Infrastructure with MFA registered, and the activity occurred at 16:45 EET which is within typical working hours. However, the source IP geolocates to Bogotá, Colombia and there is a prior related login-location anomaly from the same IP earlier that day; given the high impact of deleting a production NSG and the unusual geolocation, this activity is considered High Priority because it may represent an unexpected or unauthorized change despite a seemingly legitimate user context.
